United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)

description.narrative:
Pluralistic and independent media are essential to democracy, the rule of law, and the realization of the Sustainable Development Goals. This Workplan is dedicated to the promotion of media pluralism and diversity — fostering a creation of a media landscape where multiple voices, formats, and ownership models can thrive. Central to this are public service media, which serve the information needs of all citizens, and community media, which inform and empower local communities, reflecting the identities, languages, and concerns that mainstream media too often overlook. Together, they form the cornerstone of an inclusive and resilient information environment.
The programme described in this Workplan will build the capacity of media organizations to adopt policies and practices promoting pluralism and diversity, including gender responsible approaches. This will be achieved through the policy development, capacity building, research and knowledge sharing, promotion of professional standards, integration of innovative technological solutions, and international cooperation.
